summary.text: Margitta Mazzocchi is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 31, where she has served since 2020, and is seeking re-election against Democrat George Barker in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Margitta Mazzocchi was born in Stolberg, Germany, and earned an undergraduate degree from the Teachers College in Landau, Germany.

In a Ballotpedia survey in 2020, she said she came to West Virginia from Germany in 1999 as a legal immigrant, became a United States citizen on January 9, 2017, and decided in March 2019 to run for the House of Delegates.

Her career experience includes working as office manager and billing officer for Life Solutions Counseling Services, manager of Studio 19 Photography, and a teacher for the Recovery Group of Southern West Virginia.
Mazzocchi is a member of the National Rifle Association, the West Virginia Citizen's Defense League and the Kiwanis Club of Logan.

In the 2023-2024 session she chaired the Senior, Children, and Family Issues Committee and also served on the Education, Finance, Jails and Prisons, Political Subdivisions, and Veterans Affairs and Homeland Security committees.
